name: Rippling
tagline: Rippling is an all-in-one platform that unifies HR, payroll, IT, and spend management. Its AI features automate onboarding workflows, generate job descriptions, power custom approval chains, and provide workforce analytics. Over 10,000 companies use Rippling to manage their entire employee lifecycle.
